{{Top|leg}}
The '''Propserines''' were the fifth-highest social class on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Algara II]] below the [[Belligerency]]. They were the [[Algarian (race)|Algarians]] who worked in non-manual occupations such as [[Computer/Legends|computer]] [[Programmer/Legends|programmers]], and [[Customs official/Legends|custom officers]]. The class also included business executives, such as [[Dellin Sorth]].
